headline: Turn permit backlogs into a predictable citizen service
capabilities: Classify and validate permit applications at intake
Route requests automatically to the correct review teams
Centralize communication and provide instant updates to applicants
Provide inspectors with mobile access and real‑time assignments
outcomes: Accelerated approvals with consistent, automated workflows
Reduced status‑check calls through transparent, self‑service tracking
Improved coordination across planning, zoning, code, and inspections
Delivered a faster, more predictable permitting experience for residents
why_try: This demo makes public-sector AI immediately tangible: ask one plain-language question and expose the application, owner, review desk, or inspector that needs action next.

sample_prompts.label: Find the permit most likely to trigger a complaint
sample_prompts.prompt: Which permit applications have been sitting too long, and which resident is going to complain first?

sample_prompts.label: Triage today’s front-counter submissions
sample_prompts.prompt: Anything at the front counter I should not be accepting today?

sample_prompts.label: Route the Harbor Way restaurant fit-out
sample_prompts.prompt: The restaurant fit-out on Harbor Way just came in. Who needs to review it and when is it due back?

sample_prompts.label: Stop avoidable applicant status calls
sample_prompts.prompt: My front desk is drowning in status calls. What can we send out today so people stop calling?

sample_prompts.label: See the solar inspection board
sample_prompts.prompt: What inspections are on the board for the solar job, and who is covering them?
